overlays.roleBrief: Shipyard technician or industrial engineer working around maintainable machinery, tolerances, tools and service records.
overlays.statusReadability: Work responsibility reads through standardized worn utility clothing, tool access, repair markings and equipment quality rather than ornament.
overlays.practicalGear: Tool belt, sealed diagnostic slate, service gloves, reinforced knees and one restrained burgundy service identifier.
overlays.condition: Normal working wear: regulated repairs, faded fabric and minor stains; never chaotic rags.

overlays.roleBrief: Enlisted naval specialist responsible for a practical shipboard system or watch station.
overlays.statusReadability: Rank remains subordinate and functional: dark regulated work uniform, role patch, minimal personal accessories and durable pressure-layer details.
overlays.practicalGear: Compact headset, service identifier, gloves and one role-specific diagnostic or maintenance tool.
overlays.condition: Clean enough for watchstanding, visibly lived-in and repeatedly maintained.

overlays.roleBrief: Junior or mid-grade naval line officer responsible for watchkeeping, crew and formal orders.
overlays.statusReadability: Sharper dark-navy cut, clean protective elements, restrained collar or chest identifiers and little loose equipment.
overlays.practicalGear: Command communicator, sealed duty tablet and compact emergency pressure equipment.
overlays.condition: Disciplined daily service wear with small realistic creases and maintenance marks.

overlays.roleBrief: Senior fleet officer responsible for readiness, trained crews and preservation of strategic assets.
overlays.statusReadability: Higher-quality ivory-grey command layer over a dark pressure under-suit, strict symmetry, sparse brass authority marks and no decorative excess.
overlays.practicalGear: Command communicator and formal-but-functional sealed duty tablet.
overlays.condition: Well maintained and controlled; age and service are visible in face and small garment wear rather than grime.

overlays.roleBrief: Civil administrator handling law, access, obligations, records and institutional continuity.
overlays.statusReadability: Authority reads through precise tailoring, document tools, cleanliness and restrained insignia rather than military armor or historical costume.
overlays.practicalGear: Secure administrative slate, identity seal and compact communications unit.
overlays.condition: Professional daily wear with subtle use and no glamorous presentation.

overlays.roleBrief: High official or service noble whose legitimacy is expressed as state responsibility, not fantasy aristocratic spectacle.
overlays.statusReadability: Best material quality, controlled ivory and dark-navy layering, rare old-brass authority marks and strict cut; ornament remains sparse.
overlays.practicalGear: Secure state communicator and one formal service insignia with a practical fastening system.
overlays.condition: Carefully maintained, human and lived-in, never glossy or ceremonial-costume heavy.

overlays.roleBrief: Damaged or exhausted field-service variant of an otherwise valid Imperial role after prolonged operations.
overlays.statusReadability: Faction and rank remain legible through surviving cut, repairs, insignia placement and disciplined equipment even when dirty or damaged.
overlays.practicalGear: Patched pressure layer, emergency repair tape, used gloves and one still-functional role tool.
overlays.condition: Tired, scorched or stained with controlled field repairs; never post-apocalyptic rags and never a different art style.

overlays.roleBrief: Logistics specialist responsible for cargo, reserves, routing and delivery accountability.
overlays.statusReadability: Practical regulated utility cut with cargo-control markings, high-use pockets and restrained faction identifiers.
overlays.practicalGear: Cargo manifest slate, route communicator and standardized handling gloves.
overlays.condition: Repeatedly used but orderly service clothing; visible seam repairs and minor stains.

overlays.roleBrief: Reconnaissance and intelligence officer who communicates evidence, provenance and uncertainty.
overlays.statusReadability: Officer discipline remains visible but equipment prioritizes sensors, secure data handling and field practicality over ceremony.
overlays.practicalGear: Secure sensor/data slate, compact optics or diagnostic instrument and subdued comms gear.
overlays.condition: Controlled field wear with no cinematic spy styling.
